_comment: What an inflicted sandfall costs out of the instability budget, and how far it can reach (design 5.0).
Dearer than wounds and cheaper than blight, on purpose: a sandfall is difficulty where blight is a
verdict. You can roof over sand, and the burial hands you the glass to do it with; a blighted Age only
asks how long you stay. Consequence should reach the hazard you can answer before the one you cannot.
`most` 4 is what buys the full show -- a twenty-by-twenty column, burying deeper, living longer and
several at once. Unwalked: the four steps cost 28 on top of the 28 that seams and wounds take first, so
nothing sees the top of this without a badly broken Age, which is the intent.
